title: Nevada comparison separates Thacker Pass and Rhyolite Ridge without adding a project
summary: The existing excluded parent gains six substantive sections and a three-question comparison from retained November 21 sources. Construction, investment decisions, permit scope, rights and habitat duties remain project-specific. All four excluded project parents now display their Context boundary; GSA procurement guidance no longer appears in the Project search category.
evidence_note: November 22 is authorship and AI self-review, not a new source inspection. Eight exact retained source records and the unchanged named-dossier assessment support the comparison. The combined Phase 61 file and source-triggered Phase 63 gate remain unchanged; no Phase 60 identity or appointment is created.
publication_effect: The parent is Context with zero eligible-project contribution. The catalog has 335 readings; eligibility stays 100 projects and 70 places. All 24 original project routes and 15 original place routes now have dedicated current accounts, including excluded contexts. This is source-level coverage, not blanket content, production, release or launch acceptance.
